_note: Respellings MUST be lowercase unless you actually want the letters spoken one at a time. TTS front-ends treat an all-caps token as an acronym: 'Pih-TAH' came out as 'Pih T A H', which is why Ptah was being spelled in narration. Keep acronym entries (RPC, LLM, ...) spaced-and-capitalised on purpose; keep phonetic respellings lowercase.
